# Clinical Consensus

This folder contains topics related to established medical agreements and standard protocols for managing disease complications and treatment side effects in inflammatory bowel disease (IBD). Currently, it documents the clinical consensus on preventing osteoporosis caused by corticosteroid therapy, providing a centralized reference for agreed-upon preventative care standards derived from the Danish IBD quality database reports.

## Pages

- [[clinical-consensus|Clinical Consensus]] — Documents the general medical agreement that osteoporosis resulting from steroid treatment in IBD patients can be effectively prevented.
